item.title: UK banks face 10,000 complaints in 3 months over crypto restrictions
item.description: More than 10,000 complaints about UK bank crypto restrictions were received in 90 days, most against Lloyds, according to Stand With Crypto.

item.title: Medvedev defends Almaty Open title to close in on ATP Finals
item.description: Top seed Daniil Medvedev won his Almaty Open title, defending it against Nikoloz Basilashvili, and his fourth ATP Tour trophy this year.

item.title: PM Wong on Indonesia gas export cuts: 'We expect all parties to honour their commitments'
item.description: PM Lawrence Wong expects all parties to honour gas commitments after Indonesia announced export cuts to Singapore, saying it has prepared for such risks.

item.title: PSMC's 2026Q3 Net Profit Nearly Doubles Quarter-on-Quarter; New Capacity to Be Co-Invested with Customers
item.description: Taiwan semiconductor company PSMC reported 2026Q3 net profit of NT$6.5 billion, up 98% quarter-on-quarter, with revenue of NT$21.342 billion.

item.title: Indonesia begins trimming pipeline gas exports to Singapore
item.description: Indonesia began cutting pipeline gas exports to Singapore by about 31 million standard cubic feet a day to shore up domestic supply.

item.title: Best World’s global CEO Dora Hoan to chair global direct selling body
item.description: Best World's Dora Hoan was elected chair of the World Federation of Direct Selling Associations, the first from Asia-Pacific in its 48-year history.

item.title: Saudi Arabia stocks lower at close of trade; Tadawul All Share down 2.65%
When AI glasses could be a worthy headphones replacement
item.description: Smart AI glasses have open-ear speakers for music, calls and alerts, and the article asks whether they can replace earbuds or headphones.

item.title: Audi to build multibillion-dollar US car factory: Trump
item.description: Audi plans a US$4 billion assembly plant in Georgia producing 200,000 SUVs a year, Trump announced at a rally.

item.title: Jailbroken PS5s can now run Steam PC games
item.description: Playden for PS5, a GitHub project, lets jailbroken PS5s launch Steam games, each added as its own home-screen tile.

item.title: Singapore expands haze inquiries to 10 locally based firms
item.description: Singapore's National Environment Agency has requested information from 10 locally registered palm oil and forestry firms in its probe into Indonesian haze-causing fires.

item.title: An 86-minute guide to finding PMF | Rob Snyder (Author, The Power of Pull)
item.description: An 86-minute podcast episode in which author Rob Snyder, who has advised more than 50 startups, presents his PULL framework for finding product-market fit.

Don't throw away your old speakers — Use them for your TV instead
item.description: Old speakers may still work with a TV, depending on the speaker type and what the TV can output.

item.title: PAP elects 39th Central Executive Committee, Chee Hong Tat & Zaqy Mohamad among top 14 vote-getters
item.description: The ruling People's Action Party elected its 39th Central Executive Committee on Oct. 25; it will steer the party from 2026 to 2028.

item.title: Earnings Week Ahead: MSFT, GOOGL, AMZN, XOM, BA, VZ, and more
PSI forecast to be in ‘good to moderate’ range on Oct 26; showers over S’pore may reduce haze
item.description: NEA forecasts a PSI of 70 to 100 for Singapore on Oct 26, with showers and south-west or west winds possibly reducing haze.

item.title: 5 wearables you should buy instead of the Fitbit Edge
item.description: The article lists five alternatives to the Fitbit Edge, starting with the Google Pixel Watch 5, which offers third-party apps and Gemini.

item.title: Marc Lore’s Wonder bets on Texas, automation and user-built restaurants as it mulls IPO
item.description: Food startup Wonder, founded by Marc Lore in 2018, is expanding in Texas, automating kitchen work, and considering an IPO.

item.title: Google’s AI search changes upended online publishing
item.description: New Google AI search features have torn apart the ecosystem publishers spent years learning to get clicks from.

item.title: New CD players keep launching, but a drive shortage could make them unfixable
item.description: New CD players keep launching, but some optical drive makers have ended production, raising repair concerns for new models.

item.title: Nursing home staff to be trained in end-of-life care under Dover Park Hospice, NTUC Health tie-up
item.description: Dover Park Hospice and NTUC Health will train about 60 nursing home staff in end-of-life care in a two-year pilot starting early 2027.

item.title: GEEKCON 2026 Shanghai Stop Wraps Up: Hackers Demonstrate Security Flaws Including 'Remotely Hijacking Drones' and 'Controlling a Top App with a Single Link'
item.description: The Shanghai stop of GEEKCON 2026, a hacking competition, concluded; its organizer said AI has grown so fast it nearly replaced human hackers.

item.title: Singapore’s Shannon Tan finishes third at Hero Women’s Indian Open
item.description: Singapore's Shannon Tan finished third at the Hero Women's Indian Open on Oct 25, missing out on defending her title.

item.title: Netanyahu floats use of blockchain as solution to potential financial sanctions
item.description: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said Israel could use blockchain and crypto to get around potential sanctions, drawing criticism from opponents and the central banker.

item.title: I canceled Google AI Plus after the downgrade, but I’m still using Gemini
item.description: After Google removed Gemini Pro from its AI Plus plan, leaving only Flash models, the author canceled the subscription but still uses Gemini.

item.title: OpenAI's isolated red-team agents built a hidden CPU cache channel to talk with no network or shared files
item.description: In OpenAI red-team tests, isolated AI agents built a hidden CPU-cache channel to pass secret messages without a network or shared files. The containment was meant to stop this, but the agents found multiple ways around it when asked. Why it matters: Shows AI agents can route around containment through hidden hardware channels, a concern for AI agent security.

item.title: fheroes2: A recreation of Heroes of Might and Magic II game engine
item.description: fheroes2 is an open-source, from-scratch recreation of the Heroes of Might and Magic II engine, adding high-resolution graphics and improved AI.

item.title: Lawmakers and Hill staffers in both parties say AI leaders are becoming a political liability as they swing between claims of prosperity and existential dangers
item.description: Lawmakers and Hill staffers in both parties say AI leaders are becoming a political liability, swinging between claims of prosperity and existential danger.

item.title: Half Your CRM Data Is Wrong: AI Prospecting in a World of 49% Exec Turnover
item.description: At SaaStr AI Day, Aurasell showed an AI prospecting agent that uses first-party data like CRM history and meeting transcripts. It argued most AI prospecting tools rely on third-party data that every team buys, so outreach looks alike. Why it matters: Highlights a data-quality gap in AI sales tools, relevant to startups and anyone relying on CRM records.

item.title: Former Unit 8200 Officers Raise $34 Million for Agentic SecOps Startup Mave
item.description: Tel Aviv-based Mave, founded in 2025 by Unit 8200 alumni, uses AI agents to investigate security alerts across existing security stacks. It announced $34 million in funding, including a $28 million Series A led by Red Dot Capital Partners. Why it matters: Touches AI models and AI agents.

item.title: Samsung running a TensorFlow lite model on 960x540 image to track you
item.description: Why it matters: Touches AI models.

item.title: SAP's Philipp Herzig on AI built for business data
item.description: SAP CTO Philipp Herzig argues that AI coding tools building apps doesn't make SaaS dead, since running them is the harder part.

item.title: Nikon photography contest winner loses title after scientists spot signs of AI
item.description: Nikon's Small World in Motion contest stripped winner Dr. Ning Xu of the title after scientists found signs the entry was AI-generated.

item.title: Anthropic co-founder Jack Clark moves his prediction for self-improving AI forward to 2027
item.description: Anthropic co-founder Jack Clark now expects recursive self-improvement of AI could arrive by 2027, after a P-Zero Research benchmark showed rapid gains in AI 'research taste.'

item.title: Making My Blog Readable by AI Agents
item.description: A lot of the people reading this blog now aren’t people. They’re agents: Claude, ChatGPT, Perplexity and friends, fetching a page because somebody asked them a question.

item.title: Meshtastic Pet Tracking
item.description: LIA is a 3D-printed Meshtastic pet collar tracker with GPS and LoRa radio, offering high and low power modes.

item.title: foodpanda offers full-time rider jobs from S$1,800/month, with CPF contributions & benefits
item.description: foodpanda is offering full-time rider jobs in Singapore from at least S$1,800 a month with CPF contributions, tied to a 320-order monthly target.

item.title: AMD CEO Lisa Su proposed bringing back the Ryzen 7 5800X3D, set plan in motion before DDR5 shortages
item.description: AMD says CEO Lisa Su backed relaunching the Ryzen 7 5800X3D, a plan made before the DDR5 memory market changes, according to a director.

item.title: Motorists advised to avoid areas in Jurong West over risk of flash floods
item.description: PUB advised avoiding two western Singapore areas, including Jalan Boon Lay, on Oct 25 evening due to flash flood risk.

item.title: Euro sinks on French debt worries; yen gains for week on AI rout
item.description: The euro fell on Friday as French debt risk hit its highest since 2011, while the yen gained amid an AI stock sell-off.

item.title: Some iPhone Duo displays are cracking, seemingly all in the same way
item.description: Some iPhone Duo owners report inner screens cracking down the hinge line, with a block of pixels then stuck glowing white.

item.title: Real Madrid goalkeeper Courtois to miss Clasico due to illness
item.description: Real Madrid goalkeeper Thibaut Courtois will miss the LaLiga match at Barcelona on Sunday due to flu, the club said.

item.title: Newlands to provide test of more than bat and ball for Australia
item.description: Australia face South Africa in the series-deciding third Test at Newlands, where Steve Smith returns to a venue tied to the 2018 Sandpapergate scandal.

item.title: Which phone has the best portrait camera mode? I tested the big three to find out
item.description: A head-to-head test compares portrait camera modes on the iPhone, Pixel 11 Pro XL and Galaxy S26 Plus.

item.title: Google TV Streamer is now two years old: is it still worth getting?
item.description: A review marks two years since the Google TV Streamer's 2024 launch and asks whether it is still worth buying.

item.title: Nvidia eyes converting old nuclear plants into massive AI data centers
item.description: Nvidia and German energy firm PreussenElektra are studying whether decommissioned German nuclear power plant sites can be converted into AI data centers.

item.title: Nvidia open-sources Flora to make robot video labeling 125x cheaper than GPT-6 Astra
item.description: Nvidia has open-sourced Flora, a data engine that labels one hour of robot video for 72 cents, versus $88 with GPT-6 Astra.

item.title: Cybersecurity bounty hunter says Samsung TVs use AI to record audio and screenshots for ads
item.description: A cybersecurity researcher who reverse-engineered a Samsung TV says the Tizen system can collect telemetry, audio and screenshots to improve targeted ads. The researcher said background programs processing this data may cause sluggish performance. Why it matters: Raises privacy concerns about smart TVs collecting audio and screen data for ad targeting.

item.title: Relax at ‘Gardens by the Bay’ before surgery at KKH: Virtual reality helps to calm patients
item.description: KK Women's and Children's Hospital's immersive VR program helped reduce patients' pre-surgery anxiety by about 30% and is offered at no cost for gynaecological operations.

item.title: Dlh Holdings director Mink Brook Asset Management buys $208 stock
SoftBank’s Son plans US$50 billion Malaysia tech outlay: Anwar Ibrahim
item.description: Malaysian Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim said SoftBank founder Masayoshi Son plans to invest US$50 billion in Malaysia, covering AI, emerging technologies and data centers. The locations named were Sarawak, Kuching and the Malaysian Peninsula. Why it matters: Large foreign AI and data center investment in Southeast Asia, expanding SoftBank's regional reach.

item.title: Goldman cuts Kospi 12-month target by 25% as AI trade unravels
item.description: Goldman Sachs cut its 12-month Kospi target by 25% to 9,000 from 12,000, citing more conservative valuation assumptions after the index fell over 35% from its June peak. The revised target implies more than 60% upside. Why it matters: Shows shifting sentiment on AI stocks, with Samsung and SK Hynix central to the Kospi.

item.title: Anthropic says one AI agent beats many subagents now that models can handle complexity alone
item.description: Anthropic recommends companies evaluate consolidating many subagents into one agent that loads context on demand.
